title: Source-Bound Evidence for Physical-Option-Dependent Crop-Root State

initialize_rootextension_1785_1825.all_modes: rdpot initialized from rd; noddrz then derived by scanning zbotcp against current rd

update_rootextension_1829_1950.SWRD_1: rdpot is recalculated from DVS and actual rd is assigned from rdpot
update_rootextension_1829_1950.SWRD_2_potential: rdpot is incremented from its previous value by a bounded potential extension
update_rootextension_1829_1950.SWRD_2_actual: rd is incremented from its previous value by stress/assimilation-conditioned rr and may therefore lag rdpot
update_rootextension_1829_1950.SWRD_3: rdpot is recalculated from WRTPOT and actual rd is recalculated from WRT
update_rootextension_1829_1950.noddrz: noddrz_old is retained only across the same crop update; new noddrz is re-derived by scanning grid geometry after rd changes

ownership_consequence.rr_and_noddrz_old: same-update intermediate/result unless another qualified process contract proves a cross-transaction need

initialize_cumdens_2103_2156.behavior: construct relative root-density samples over the maximum root zone, integrate them and normalize the cumulative distribution
initialize_cumdens_2103_2156.ownership_consequence: for non-adaptive distribution the normalized cumulative profile is reconstructible from immutable parameters and grid

update_rootdistribution_2076_2099.SWRDC_nonadaptive: skip dynamic per-node redistribution; update_cumdens_top uses the already parameter-derived cumulative profile

update_wroot_node_2160_2235.behavior: root growth and death are redistributed per node using prior root biomass and uptake/stress weights
update_wroot_node_2160_2235.ownership_consequence: SWRDC=1 requires an optional committed per-node root-distribution state such as wroot_node or a scientifically equivalent representation

update_cumdens_2239_2275.behavior: sum current wroot_node and normalize cumulative root biomass over the rooted nodes
update_cumdens_2239_2275.ownership_consequence: cumdens is a derived normalized representation, not the irreducible adaptive state

update_cumdens_top_2279_2301.behavior: sample the normalized cumulative distribution at compartment-top/root-zone-relative positions using noddrz/grid geometry
update_cumdens_top_2279_2301.ownership_consequence: cumdens_top is a read-only derived view field and should not be an independent commit authority

finalize_wroot_node_2322_2361.behavior: derive per-node root weights from cumulative fractions and WRT, then derive LRV and interface root-density quantities
finalize_wroot_node_2322_2361.ownership_consequence: wroot_node_top and lrv_node are derived diagnostics/process inputs when their consuming physics is active; they are not automatically mandatory persistent state

option_matrix.view_basis: current root geometry + committed adaptive distribution state + immutable grid

important_nonclaims: The exact SWAP5 crop-host state type is not defined here.
The exact data structure for adaptive per-node root state is not fixed here; SoA/pool/batch layouts remain allowed.
This evidence does not qualify a root-growth update implementation.
This evidence does not qualify arbitrary subdaily root-growth cadence.
This evidence does not qualify potential transpiration production.
A future view producer must source-bind B1.10 node-boundary and cumulative-distribution mapping rather than merely approximating them.
